title: Power torsion in the conormal module of a completed retraction
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian ring, $J\subseteq R$ an ideal, and $S$ a finite type commutative $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Suppose $\operatorname{Spec}S\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is etale over $\operatorname{Spec}R\setminus V(J)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Put $\widehat R=\varprojlim_n R/J^n$ and $\widehat S=\varprojlim_n S/J^nS$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], with the induced structural map $\widehat R\to\widehat S$. For every $\widehat R$-algebra homomorphism $\sigma:\widehat S\to\widehat R$, put $K=\ker\sigma$. There exists an integer $c\geq0$ such that $J^c(K/K^2)=0$. Here $K/K^2$ is the quotient module of the ideal $K$ by its square, with $R$-action through $R\to\widehat S$; the displayed equality means that every element of $J^c$ acts as zero on this module.

source.place: Tag 0AKJ (lemma-fully-faithful-etale-over-complement), first paragraph of existence for A=C, applying Tag 0ALQ (lemma-rig-etale), part (1), and Tag 0ALM (lemma-exact-sequence-NL) to the surjective completed retraction. Only its conormal annihilation assertion is extracted, before algebraization or henselian lifting.
